# NET-007: ufw-docker is loaded and lets tailnet traffic reach published ports

- **Group:** Firewall and exposure
- **Severity when it fails:** high
- **Root:** the full result needs `sudo`. Without root this check may report `unknown`; it never reports a pass it could not verify.

## Why it matters

ufw-docker adds a block to /etc/ufw/after.rules that only takes effect after ufw reload; until then published ports are unfiltered. Once loaded it also drops tailnet traffic to published ports unless a route rule allows it on tailscale0, using the container port, not the host port.

## Verify by hand

```sh
grep -n 'BEGIN UFW AND DOCKER' /etc/ufw/after.rules; sudo iptables -S DOCKER-USER; sudo ufw status | grep FWD
```

## How to fix it

ufw reload; then ufw route allow in on tailscale0 proto tcp to any port <container-port>

## What a fix can break

ufw reload applies every pending rule change at once; review ufw status first.
